description: EXPR-DOMAIN, deciding variant: which duplicate match DLookup, DFirst and DLast return, by key layout. Dd (primary key on id), DdI (primary key and an index on g) and DdN (no key, no index) hold rows (id, g, v) = (3,1,30), (1,1,10), (2,1,20), (4,2,40), (5,1,50), (6,2,60) in that insertion order. Asks DLookup, DFirst, DLast, DMin and DMax of v where g = 1, DLookup without criteria, and the plain scan order of g = 1 rows, for each table. Follow-up probe (status F) for EXPR-DOMAIN; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
